finance.price_recomputation_authority: Run unchanged audit_mvp_acceptance_v2.py as well; this sidecar binds call amounts to ledger, not an independent tariff oracle.

limitations: This supplement never changes original MVP gates, histories or verdicts; run the unchanged fixed-nine and CLI audits separately.
Original rejected/failed attempts remain rejected/failed even if their transport or conversion can be verified.
Missing/truncated/legacy response and application evidence stays unknown; absence is never acceptance.
No production normalizer is used as oracle; original source line IDs independently reconstruct complete candidate bytes and standard public diffs.
Partial improvements can remain KEEP while final target is false; later REVERT is not a replacement for the selected configuration.
Known-call subtotal and fully-known-run subtotal are distinct; bounded actual cost remains null.
